lines.zh: 我一步步走过针叶林，树在让路。
lines.en: I walk the taiga and the trees give way.
My steps press the snow to ice.

lines.zh: 我低着头，尾巴在后面平衡。
lines.en: Head low, my tail balances behind.
I break a fallen log and keep walking.
My shadow is longer than the trees'.
I round a stand of brush.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，松枝上的雪就落。
lines.en: Each step shakes snow from the pines.

lines.zh: 暴龙走过，草都朝一边倒。
lines.en: Where the rex walks, grass bends one way.

lines.zh: 这片针叶林，我熟得像自己的窝。
lines.en: I know this taiga like my own den.
I duck below a branch.
I stop and listen.
I walk deeper into the trees.
One of my teeth is broken.
I lift my head to the smell of resin.
I stand in the wood without moving.

lines.zh: 针叶林里很冷，我不在乎。
lines.en: The taiga is cold. I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在空气里成了白雾。
lines.en: My breath turns white in the air.

lines.zh: 我盯着远处的一条小径。
lines.en: I watch a trail in the distance.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴慢慢扫了一下。
lines.en: I sweep my tail slowly once.

lines.zh: 有只鸟落在枝上，又飞了。
lines.en: A bird landed and left again.

lines.zh: 我的前肢很短，没什么用。
lines.en: My forelimbs are short and of little use.

lines.zh: 我换一条腿撑住这身骨头。
lines.en: I shift onto the other leg to hold this bulk.
Snow settles on my back.
I wait for one that takes the wrong path.
I open my jaws and close them.

lines.zh: 我的骨头里有一股力气。
lines.en: There is a strength in these bones.
I know the smell of this wood.
I turn my head slowly.
You stand between two trees.
You are not the height of one of my toes.
When I open my jaws, you should move.

lines.zh: 这片松林只留我一个气味。
lines.en: This pine wood keeps only my scent.

lines.zh: 你的热气在冷空气里发白。
lines.en: Your heat steams white in the cold air.

lines.zh: 你不出这条林线，我不动。
lines.en: Stay behind this treeline and I will not move.
My teeth are not for show.

lines.zh: 你站得这么久，倒有意思。
lines.en: That you stand so long is interesting.

lines.zh: 我今天已经吃过一次了。
lines.en: I have eaten once today already.
You carry no other scent.
I lower my head level with you.
You had better not run.

lines.zh: 这一下划破了我腿上的皮。
lines.en: That opened the skin on my leg.

lines.zh: 我痛得吼叫，震落松上雪。
lines.en: I roar with the pain and snow falls.
My blood burns red spots into the snow.
I turn my head and fix on it.
This wound is not enough to stop me.

lines.zh: 我这一声吼，林子都静了。
lines.en: One roar of mine and the wood goes silent.
One of my teeth is loose.

lines.zh: 肋骨疼得发闷，我吼不出来。
lines.en: My ribs ache dully; I cannot roar.
I will keep that in my teeth.

lines.zh: 我还没有倒下去，针叶林还在震。
lines.en: I have not fallen; the taiga still shakes.
That is not enough for one tooth.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，八十点的暴君。
lines.en: In the taiga, an eighty-health tyrant.
I will look first and not move.
Not worth lowering my head for.
I do not eat another's leavings.
It is still moving. Better.
I reach down and draw back.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，跑起来更快。
lines.en: Something that small runs better.
One bite and it is gone.
Eating that leaves me hungrier.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，像撞树干。
lines.en: You hit my leg like a trunk.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我尾巴都没晃。
lines.en: You struck me and my tail did not swing.
Get clear. I am stepping.

lines.zh: 你退了，我就不迈这一步。
lines.en: You backed off, so I hold this step.

lines.zh: 针叶林里撞一下，我不在意。
lines.en: A bump in the taiga. I do not mind.
Stay clear of my claws.
Did my tail catch you?
That knocked you half a step back.
The snow crunched under me.
Do not do that twice.
There is one more of my kind in this wood.

lines.zh: 它比我小一些，牙也更短。
lines.en: It is smaller than me, with shorter teeth.
We met at a stream.
We stood facing each other a long while.
Neither lowered its head first.
It went north.
I left scent on this side.
We may meet again next year.

lines.zh: 这种身体，独来独往惯了。
lines.en: A body like this gets used to being alone.
The wood is large enough for two.
I take up a bone.
Too light. It crumbles in my jaws.
I drag the carcass under a tree.
Half a carcass in the brush.

lines.zh: 我一只脚压住那具尸体。
lines.en: One foot pins the carcass.
This meat is still warm.
This bone goes into the snow.
That much on the ground I leave.

lines.zh: 我一口吞了，骨头也不剩。
lines.en: I swallow it, bones and all.
Enough to last until tomorrow.
Something moves behind a tree.

lines.zh: 鼻孔一开一合，我闻到了。
lines.en: My nostrils flare and I have the scent.
It left prints in the snow.
I walk toward those prints.

lines.zh: 我一张嘴，牙比你的手臂长。
lines.en: When I open my mouth, my teeth outrun your arm.
Three strides and it is mine.
I put my snout down against the snow.
It stands in a clearing.
Nothing there can block me.

lines.zh: 它转过脸，正撞上我的眼。
lines.en: It turned and met my eye.

lines.zh: 它看见我了，那就开始吧。
lines.en: It sees me. Then we begin.
Then there is nothing left to hide.

lines.zh: 我踩碎冻土，一步步逼近。
lines.en: I crush the frozen soil, step by step.
The snow sounds under my feet.
It slips between the trunks.
These trees will not stop me.
I break a small tree aside.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我的脚步先到。
lines.en: In the pines, my footsteps arrive first.
I slow my pace.
No hurry. It will not get far.

lines.zh: 前面是一片开阔的雪地。
lines.en: There is open snow ahead.

lines.zh: 到了那里，它就没办法了。
lines.en: Out there it has nothing to use.
It turned left.
I turn with it.
Its legs are sinking in the snow.
My feet are broad and I do not sink.

lines.zh: 我每一步都吃掉一段距离。
lines.en: Every stride eats the distance.
Its pace breaks and it stumbles in the snow.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我的脚步很重。
lines.en: In the spruce forest, my steps are heavy.
This stride is a long one.
Now it is in reach.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我的脚步最响。
lines.en: In the conifers my steps are loudest.
The jaws shut and bone breaks.
I whip it up into the air.
It strikes a tree.
My foot comes down across its shoulder.
It breaks free and runs uphill.
One stride and I am on it.
My jaws take its flank.
It cried out. Briefly.
My teeth close and the bone breaks.
The snow has gone red.
I lift my head with the grip still in my teeth.
It is still moving. I do not let go.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，踩断一根倒木。
lines.en: I shake my head and snap a fallen log.

lines.zh: 吼声过后，雪又落回原处。
lines.en: After the roar the snow settles back.

lines.zh: 我把猎物拖进松树底下。
lines.en: I drag the kill beneath a pine.

lines.zh: 我从针叶林深处走出来。
lines.en: I walk out of the deep taiga.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸震落松枝上的雪。
lines.en: My breath shakes snow off the pine boughs.
The ground dips under my steps.
There are one or two of us here.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，闻了闻冷空气。
lines.en: I raise my head and scent the cold air.
My shadow lies across the snow.
I set my tail straight.
There is a small stream far off.
I walk toward the treeline.
The snow here is unbroken.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，呼出一口白气。
lines.en: I open my jaws and a white cloud comes out.
I lower my head for a scent.

lines.zh: 我的头骨顶得上一个人。
lines.en: My skull is as big as a person.

lines.zh: 我一转身，尾巴扫倒蕨丛。
lines.en: I turn and my tail sweeps down the ferns.

lines.zh: 林子那么大，我走得很慢。
lines.en: The wood is vast. I walk slowly.
I set a forefoot into the snow.
Fire caught my hide and I shook my head.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下，砸断了树。
lines.en: I rolled down the slope and broke a tree.

lines.zh: 水进了我的肺，我挣不出来。
lines.en: Water is in my lungs and I cannot thrash free.

lines.zh: 爆风把我推得退了三大步。
lines.en: The blast shoved me back three strides.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进了我的脖子。
lines.en: An arrow is in my neck.
Strange force holds me down.
Two days unfed and my legs have gone weak.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning struck my back and numbed me.

lines.zh: 脚下的雪没了，我掉下去。
lines.en: The snow under me vanished and I fell.
